Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 국립중앙과학관. Its tags are 과학관, 지역, 국립, 공립, 사립. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
